associations.rationale: The type gives a complete list of simple affine-group representations and their dimensions and counts for finite fields of cardinality greater than two, directly furnishing the corresponding referenced classification case.

The type gives the same complete affine classification directly for the displayed Problem4_12_6.Affine group when the field has cardinality greater than two, matching one of the problems the source directs the reader to redo.

The type directly gives the complete affine-group classification in the cardinality-two case, including exhaustiveness and the dimensions of both simple representations, furnishing that case of the referenced affine problem.

The type directly gives the complete cardinality-two classification for the displayed Problem4_12_6.Affine group, including exhaustiveness and one-dimensionality, furnishing that case of the problem named by the source.

The formal type directly supplies an exhaustive pairwise nonisomorphic list of simple dihedral-group representations with the odd and even dimension counts, furnishing the referenced dihedral classification.
The type directly gives the exhaustive simple-representation classification and dimension counts for the finite Heisenberg group, furnishing the referenced Heisenberg problem.
The formal type states the same exhaustive classification directly for the displayed Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg group, matching one of the problems explicitly named by the source.
